slug: 2025-09-01 Mauritius Establishes Inter-Ministerial Committee to Drive Digital Strategy

facts.fact: We Are Tech Africa says the government's 'national digital strategy' was 'unveiled in May 2025'; it names no adopting act or body and does not name the strategy.

The government established an inter-ministerial committee to coordinate implementation of the national digital strategy; its inaugural meeting took place on 26 August 2025 in Ebene, chaired by the Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation, as a single point of contact across ministries.

systems.owner: Government of Mauritius; Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation

note: The article does not name or describe the strategy's scope, so both facts carry an empty class; the date and the role of the ministry-chaired committee are stated.
